questions.stem: In a series of figures, the first three are squares with 1, 2, 3 dots respectively. The next figure most logically would be a square with:
questions.explanation: Pattern: each next square has one more dot than the previous (1, 2, 3, ?). Next = 4. Distractor 1 doubles (would give 6). Distractor 3 squares position (4²=16, mismatch). Distractor 4 — no reason to restart.

questions.stem: Each step of a series has 1 more side than the previous shape: triangle (3), square (4), pentagon (5), ?. The next shape is:

options.option_text: A heptagon, having seven sides total
A hexagon, having six sides total
An octagon, having eight sides total
A quadrilateral, having four sides total

questions.explanation: Pattern: 3, 4, 5, 6, ... → hexagon (6 sides). Distractor 1 = 7 sides (skipped a step). Distractor 3 = 8 sides. Distractor 4 = quad goes back to 4.

questions.stem: Symbols in a sequence: △, △△, △△△, △△△△, ?. The next group has:
questions.explanation: Linear count: 1, 2, 3, 4, → 5. Distractor 1 jumps by 2. Distractor 3 doubles. Distractor 4 restarts.

questions.stem: A clock-rotation pattern: at step 1 hand at 12, step 2 at 3, step 3 at 6, step 4 at 9. At step 5 the hand will point at:
questions.explanation: Each step the hand rotates 90° clockwise: 12→3→6→9→12. Cycle of 4. Step 5 returns to start (12). Distractor 1, 3, 4 are intermediate positions.

questions.stem: Pattern series: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?. The next number is:
questions.explanation: Geometric series: each term doubles the previous. 16 × 2 = 32. Distractor 20 = 16+4 (arithmetic). Distractor 24 = 16+8. Distractor 30 = 16+14.
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.topic: Non-verbal pattern recognition (text descriptions) — mixed tiers

questions.stem: In the sequence 'A, BB, CCC, DDDD, ?', the next group has:
questions.explanation: Pattern: nth term = n copies of the nth letter. Position 5 → letter E, 5 copies → EEEEE. Distractor 1 keeps the letter D. Distractor 3 advances letter but keeps count 4. Distractor 4 jumps count to 6.
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.topic: Non-verbal pattern recognition (text descriptions) — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A grid pattern shows: row 1 has 1 box, row 2 has 4 boxes, row 3 has 9 boxes. Row 4 will have:
questions.explanation: Row n has n² boxes: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ... (perfect squares). Row 4 = 16. Distractor 1 = 9+3. Distractor 3 = 9+1. Distractor 4 = 9+11.
